name: barbell 2 3 deadlift
description: A deadlift variation with a two-thirds range of motion. It is a good way to drill the lower, hardest part of the lift.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over your midfoot.
Grip the bar, brace your core, and set your back in a neutral position.
Push the floor away and lift the bar through roughly the lower two-thirds of a normal deadlift, stopping before full lockout.
Lower the bar to the floor under control and reset before the next rep.
